title: struthanthus vulgaris
intro: Struthanthus vulgaris, commonly known as Yellow Passionflower or Yellow Passion Vine, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Struthanthus vulgaris include its ability to act as a tranquilizer, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, providing relief from muscle spasms, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
